note: Words `vibes lint` flags by default that this repo genuinely uses. Each is scoped to the files where it is real vocabulary, so the rule stays on everywhere else — see Vibes/bindings/CLAIMS.md.

allow.why: GitHub's own names for a token's scope and shape. The operator pastes a token and reads these words on GitHub's page; there is no plainer word for them.
The fault badge shows the fault's wire name verbatim, and this claim quotes what the operator sees. The test pins the exact string because spelling drift once broke the badge.
Parallax's names for the P2 boot ROM's serial commands — the literal text on the wire, and what the P2 documentation and every loader call them.
The flash-boot stub is Parallax's name for the block a flash image carries ahead of the firmware. Elsewhere `stub` means a test double, which is machinery and stays flagged.
The same Parallax flash-boot stub, run on the instruction-set simulator.
